days.title: Glaciers and Summits
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Seilandsjøkelen
stops.detail: The landscape in the park is very diverse, as the park extends over the low mountain range on the island in addition to the fjords and coastal landscapes and even includes the two glaciers Seilandsjøkelen and Nordmannsjøkelen.

stops.name: Seilandstuva
stops.detail: The highest mountain in the park is the Seilandstuva at 1,079 m.

stops.name: Store Kufjord
stops.detail: The two largest fjords are Store Kufjord and Jøfjord, which are located in the south of the island and both run in a north-south direction.

stops.name: Melkelva
stops.detail: To the southeast of the Seilandsjøkelen there is a high plateau through which the Melkelva flows.
